- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. content.text:
q24.

The call chain for creating a memo, one hop per file:

- `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` — the `useCreateMemo()` mutation hook (line 178), which calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo(...)`
- `web/src/connect.ts` — `memoServiceClient` is created here via `createClient(MemoService, transport)` (line 197)
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` — the `rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)` definition (line 21)
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — the gRPC handler `(*APIV1Service).CreateMemo` (line 70), which calls the store
- `store/memo.go` — the store method `(*Store).CreateMemo` (line 109), which dispatches to the configured database driver
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` — the SQLite driver's `(*DB).CreateMemo` (line 16), which builds and executes the `INSERT INTO memo ...` statement

(The MySQL and Postgres equivalents live at `store/db/mysql/memo.go:16` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`; the frontend proto types are generated into `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.)
